# NEW 2026-11-20 v6.7 batch 12 fs-frontier2, the frontier programme (part A, steps 1-3). Generated by gen_frontier.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# ======================================================================== part A, the frontier programme (design 3.3)
# One programme per historical region (2-39), at most three at once (slots oe_fs_p1-3 on BYZ, see the notes for why
# slots and not a list). Steps: 1 register (built), 2 settlers (built: calls oe_col_start), 3 forts and soldier-farmers
# (built: oe_fs.12; vanilla castle, oe_ti_settle_foreign / _native, the officials menu's pronoia grant), 4 backers and
# 5 romanisation (named places: a parked programme waits at step 4 in the BYZ list oe_fs_done).
# BYZ scope. The scheduler row 29 calls this (hook): part B's month, then part A's.
oe_fs_monthly_all = {
    oe_fs_monthly = yes
    oe_fs_a_monthly = yes
    oe_fs_b_monthly = yes
}
# BYZ scope, monthly. At most one event a month: step 2's try and step 3's event both wait for a free main-line lock.
oe_fs_a_monthly = {
    if = { limit = { current_month = 1 } oe_fs_a_january = yes }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_e12 NOT = { oe_fs_ev_12 = yes } } oe_fs_e12_clear = yes }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_p1 } var:oe_fs_p1 = { save_scope_as = oe_fs_pc } oe_fs_tick_1 = yes }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_p2 } var:oe_fs_p2 = { save_scope_as = oe_fs_pc } oe_fs_tick_2 = yes }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_p3 } var:oe_fs_p3 = { save_scope_as = oe_fs_pc } oe_fs_tick_3 = yes }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_p1 } NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_p2 } NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_p3 } } remove_variable = oe_fs_a_on }
}
# BYZ scope, January. Step 1's modifier renewed on the programmes' land (land gained during the year joins now); the
# AI's roll (design 3.3.1: 25 %).
oe_fs_a_january = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_p1 } var:oe_fs_p1 = { save_scope_as = oe_fs_pc } oe_fs_reg_mark = yes }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_p2 } var:oe_fs_p2 = { save_scope_as = oe_fs_pc } oe_fs_reg_mark = yes }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_p3 } var:oe_fs_p3 = { save_scope_as = oe_fs_pc } oe_fs_reg_mark = yes }
    if = { limit = { oe_fs_ai_ok = yes } random = { chance = 25 oe_fs_ai_open = yes } }
}
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_fs_pc. Step 1 (the register): the empire's land in the region gets oe_fs_prog_loc.
oe_fs_reg_mark = {
    every_owned_location = {
        limit = { var:oe_theme_region ?= scope:oe_fs_pc.var:oe_theme_region }
        add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_fs_prog_loc months = 13 mode = replace }
    }
}
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_fs_open_c = a region centre. THE opening of a programme, free of charge (design 4.2: the strong
# route's .2 c may call it; the action and the AI pay first). Refused (oe_fs_aerr 1) when the centre may not open,
# no slot is free or the empire is not calm.
oe_fs_prog_open = {
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_fs_open_c scope:oe_fs_open_c = { oe_fs_center_ok = yes } oe_fs_slot_free = yes oe_fs_calm = yes }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_p1 } } oe_fs_take_1 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_p2 } } oe_fs_take_2 = yes }
        else = { oe_fs_take_3 = yes }
        scope:oe_fs_open_c = { set_variable = { name = oe_fs_stage value = 1 } save_scope_as = oe_fs_pc }
        oe_fs_reg_mark = yes
        set_variable = oe_fs_a_on
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_a_n } } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_a_n value = 0 } }
        change_variable = { name = oe_fs_a_n add = 1 }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_park_n } } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_park_n value = 0 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_lost_n } } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_lost_n value = 0 } }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_fs_aerr value = 1 } }
}
# BYZ scope. The worker oe_fs.91: job 1 the action's opening (paid), 31-36 the options of oe_fs.12.
oe_fs_a_work = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_fs_ajob ?= 1 }
        var:oe_fs_open_at ?= { save_scope_as = oe_fs_open_c }
        remove_variable = oe_fs_open_at
        if = {
            limit = { oe_fs_can_open = yes exists = scope:oe_fs_open_c scope:oe_fs_open_c = { oe_fs_center_ok = yes } }
            oe_fs_auth_add = { amount = -3 }
            add_gold = -100
            oe_fs_prog_open = yes
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = oe_fs_aerr value = 1 } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_ajob var:oe_fs_ajob >= 31 var:oe_fs_ajob <= 36 oe_fs_ev_12 = yes }
        var:oe_fs_ev_pc = { save_scope_as = oe_fs_pc }
        remove_variable = oe_fs_r3
        if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_ajob = 31 } oe_fs_fort_do = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_ajob = 32 } oe_fs_settle_do = { how = foreign r = 3 } }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_ajob = 33 } oe_fs_settle_do = { how = native r = 4 } }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_ajob = 34 } oe_fs_pronoia_do = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_ajob = 36 } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_r3 value = 6 } }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_fs_ajob = 35 }
            if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_e12 ?= 1 } set_variable = oe_fs_p1_dl set_variable = { name = oe_fs_p1_dlt months = 12 } }
            else_if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_e12 ?= 2 } set_variable = oe_fs_p2_dl set_variable = { name = oe_fs_p2_dlt months = 12 } }
            else = { set_variable = oe_fs_p3_dl set_variable = { name = oe_fs_p3_dlt months = 12 } }
        }
        else = {
            if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_e12 ?= 1 } oe_fs_park_1 = yes }
            else_if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_e12 ?= 2 } oe_fs_park_2 = yes }
            else = { oe_fs_park_3 = yes }
        }
        oe_fs_e12_clear = yes
    }
    remove_variable = oe_fs_ajob
}
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_fs_pc. What oe_fs.12 offers (the sender stores it; the options and the worker read it): the fort
# site (the region's most populous border place of ours without a castle), a theme of the region that may take
# soldier-settlers, a theme of the region that may be granted pronoia.
oe_fs_prep_12 = {
    remove_variable = oe_fs_fort_at
    remove_variable = oe_fs_th_s
    remove_variable = oe_fs_th_p
    ordered_owned_location = { limit = { oe_fs_fort_site = yes } order_by = population save_scope_as = oe_fs_fs }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_fs_fs } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_fort_at value = scope:oe_fs_fs } }
    random_subject = { limit = { oe_fs_pc_theme = yes oe_ti_settle_ok = yes } save_scope_as = oe_fs_ts }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_fs_ts } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_th_s value = scope:oe_fs_ts } }
    random_subject = { limit = { oe_fs_pc_theme = yes oe_fs_pron_ok = yes } save_scope_as = oe_fs_tp }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_fs_tp } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_th_p value = scope:oe_fs_tp } }
}
# BYZ scope; var:oe_fs_fort_at. Step 3 a, engine point P6 (design 5.2), the ONE place that builds the fort (switch
# FORT = castle): a vanilla castle by script where the empire and the place can build one; self-check: the castle is
# there (oe_fs_r3 1); otherwise the stand-in modifier (oe_fs_r3 2; aerr 31 when the castle was tried).
oe_fs_fort_do = {
    var:oe_fs_fort_at ?= { save_scope_as = oe_fs_fl }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_fs_fl scope:oe_fs_fl = { owner ?= c:BYZ controller ?= c:BYZ } gold >= 150 }
        add_gold = -150
        if = {
            limit = {
                can_build_building = building_type:castle
                scope:oe_fs_fl = { can_build_building = building_type:castle NOT = { has_building = building_type:castle } }
            }
            # r23 g2 (2026-11-20): instant = yes still charged the castle's own price (about 229 gold on top of our
            # 150). cost_multiplier = 0 (vanilla's form, flavor_decisions_various.txt camara_comptos) waives it; any gold
            # the engine takes all the same is paid back at once (oe_fs_aerr 32), so the player pays the 150 the text says.
            save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_fs_g0 value = gold }
            scope:oe_fs_fl = { construct_building = { building_type = building_type:castle instant = yes cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = oe_fs_fort_paid } }
            if = {
                limit = { gold < scope:oe_fs_g0 }
                set_variable = { name = oe_fs_aerr value = 32 }
                add_gold = { value = scope:oe_fs_g0 subtract = gold }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { scope:oe_fs_fl = { has_building = building_type:castle } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_fs_r3 value = 1 }
        }
        else = {
            scope:oe_fs_fl = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_fs_fort_loc years = 20 mode = replace } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_fs_r3 value = 2 }
            if = { limit = { can_build_building = building_type:castle } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_aerr value = 31 } }
        }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_fs_r3 value = 7 } }
}
# BYZ scope; var:oe_fs_th_s. Step 3 b / c: the soldier-settler action's own effect on the theme, at its own price
# (oe_ti.40: Authority and gold). $how$ foreign or native; $r$ the result code 3 or 4.
oe_fs_settle_do = {
    var:oe_fs_th_s ?= { save_scope_as = oe_fs_ts }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_fs_ts scope:oe_fs_ts = { oe_ti_settle_ok = yes } oe_ti_can_settle = yes }
        oe_ti_auth = { amount = -3 }
        add_gold = -150
        scope:oe_fs_ts = { oe_ti_settle_$how$ = yes }
        set_variable = { name = oe_fs_r3 value = $r$ }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_fs_r3 value = 7 } }
}
# BYZ scope; var:oe_fs_th_p. Step 3 d: pronoia granted exactly as the theme officials menu grants it (gen_theme_admin.py:
# oe_theme_fiscal = 3 and oe_ti_pronoia_set, the two-year officials cooldown, the tiers refresh).
oe_fs_pronoia_do = {
    var:oe_fs_th_p ?= { save_scope_as = oe_fs_tp }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_fs_tp oe_ti_pronoia_allowed = yes scope:oe_fs_tp = { oe_fs_pron_ok = yes } }
        scope:oe_fs_tp = { set_variable = { name = oe_theme_fiscal value = 3 } oe_ti_pronoia_set = yes set_variable = { name = oe_theme_officials_cd years = 2 } set_variable = oe_theme_tiers_dirty }
        set_variable = { name = oe_fs_r3 value = 5 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_fs_r3 value = 7 } }
}
# BYZ scope. oe_fs.12 is answered or no longer valid: its records go.
oe_fs_e12_clear = {
    remove_variable = oe_fs_e12
    remove_variable = oe_fs_ev_pc
    remove_variable = oe_fs_ev_reg
    remove_variable = oe_fs_ev_r2
    remove_variable = oe_fs_ev_pick
    remove_variable = oe_fs_ev_dl
    remove_variable = oe_fs_fort_at
    remove_variable = oe_fs_th_s
    remove_variable = oe_fs_th_p
}

# BYZ scope. The AI opens a programme (it pays as the action does).
oe_fs_ai_open = {
    oe_fs_best_center = yes
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_best_c oe_fs_can_open = yes }
        var:oe_fs_best_c = { save_scope_as = oe_fs_open_c }
        oe_fs_auth_add = { amount = -3 }
        add_gold = -100
        oe_fs_prog_open = yes
    }
    remove_variable = oe_fs_best_c
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- slot 1 (BYZ variables oe_fs_p1*: the centre, its region, step, months, step 2's place and result)
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_fs_open_c. Slot 1 takes the new programme.
oe_fs_take_1 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_fs_p1 value = scope:oe_fs_open_c }
    set_variable = { name = oe_fs_p1_reg value = scope:oe_fs_open_c.var:oe_theme_region }
    set_variable = { name = oe_fs_p1_st value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_fs_p1_w value = 0 }
}
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_fs_pc = the centre of slot 1. One month of the programme (scheduler row 29, via oe_fs_a_monthly).
oe_fs_tick_1 = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { oe_fs_pc_held = yes } }
        oe_fs_drop_1 = yes
    }
    # step 1, the register: 24 months, war months not counted
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_fs_p1_st ?= 1 }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_fs_pc_paused = yes } } change_variable = { name = oe_fs_p1_w add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_p1_w >= 24 } oe_fs_enter2_1 = yes }
    }
    # step 2, the settlers: the colonisation line does the work (oe_col_start: its event, its price, its slots). Done
    # when the place we gave it carries the line's marks of a settlement (oe_col_kind and the 20-year oe_col_cd: the
    # place was sparse, i.e. without oe_col_cd, when it was picked, so an old oe_col_kind alone does not count).
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_fs_p1_st ?= 2 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_fs_p1_pick ?= { has_variable = oe_col_kind has_variable = oe_col_cd } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_fs_p1_r2 value = 1 }
            oe_fs_enter3_1 = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { NOT = { oe_fs_pc_sparse = yes } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_fs_p1_r2 value = 2 }
            oe_fs_enter3_1 = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { NOT = { oe_fs_pc_paused = yes } }
            change_variable = { name = oe_fs_p1_w add = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:oe_fs_p1_w >= 36 }
                set_variable = { name = oe_fs_p1_r2 value = 3 }
                oe_fs_enter3_1 = yes
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_p1_tcd } oe_ml_free = yes oe_col_can_resettle = yes }
                oe_fs_try_1 = yes
            }
        }
    }
    # step 3, forts and soldier-farmers: oe_fs.12 (one at a time; waits for the lock at most 6 months)
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_fs_p1_st ?= 3 }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { oe_fs_pc_paused = yes } NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_p1_dlt } NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_e12 } }
            change_variable = { name = oe_fs_p1_w add = 1 }
            if = { limit = { OR = { oe_ml_free = yes var:oe_fs_p1_w >= 6 } } oe_fs_send_12_1 = yes }
        }
    }
}
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_fs_pc. Into step 2; a region without sparse land passes it at once (result 2).
oe_fs_enter2_1 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_fs_p1_st value = 2 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_fs_p1_w value = 0 }
    scope:oe_fs_pc = { set_variable = { name = oe_fs_stage value = 2 } }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { oe_fs_pc_sparse = yes } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_fs_p1_r2 value = 2 }
        oe_fs_enter3_1 = yes
    }
}
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_fs_pc. Step 2's try: the thinnest sparse place of the region becomes the colonisation line's
# target (scope:oe_col_pick, its contract) and oe_col_start runs; self-check: the line took it as its target (aerr 21).
oe_fs_try_1 = {
    ordered_owned_location = { limit = { var:oe_theme_region ?= scope:oe_fs_pc.var:oe_theme_region oe_col_sparse = yes } order_by = oe_fs_lowpop save_scope_as = oe_col_pick }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_pick }
        set_variable = { name = oe_fs_p1_pick value = scope:oe_col_pick }
        set_variable = { name = oe_fs_p1_tcd months = 6 }
        oe_col_start = yes
        if = { limit = { NOT = { var:oe_col_target ?= scope:oe_col_pick } } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_aerr value = 21 } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_fs_pc. Into step 3.
oe_fs_enter3_1 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_fs_p1_st value = 3 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_fs_p1_w value = 0 }
    remove_variable = oe_fs_p1_tcd
    scope:oe_fs_pc = { set_variable = { name = oe_fs_stage value = 3 } }
}
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_fs_pc. The sender of oe_fs.12 for slot 1 (the numbers and places of the text first).
oe_fs_send_12_1 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_fs_e12 value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_fs_ev_pc value = scope:oe_fs_pc }
    set_variable = { name = oe_fs_ev_reg value = var:oe_fs_p1_reg }
    set_variable = { name = oe_fs_ev_r2 value = 3 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_p1_r2 } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_ev_r2 value = var:oe_fs_p1_r2 } }
    remove_variable = oe_fs_ev_pick
    if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_p1_r2 ?= 1 has_variable = oe_fs_p1_pick } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_ev_pick value = var:oe_fs_p1_pick } }
    remove_variable = oe_fs_ev_dl
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_p1_dl } set_variable = oe_fs_ev_dl }
    oe_fs_prep_12 = yes
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_fs.12
}
# BYZ scope. Step 3 is done for slot 1: the programme is parked at step 4 (backers, a later batch) and leaves the
# slots; its centre keeps oe_fs_stage = 4 and the results (oe_fs_r2, oe_fs_r3); BYZ list oe_fs_done names it.
oe_fs_park_1 = {
    var:oe_fs_p1 ?= { save_scope_as = oe_fs_pk1 }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_fs_pk1 }
        scope:oe_fs_pk1 = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_fs_stage value = 4 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_fs_r2 value = 3 }
            if = { limit = { c:BYZ = { has_variable = oe_fs_p1_r2 } } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_r2 value = c:BYZ.var:oe_fs_p1_r2 } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_fs_r3 value = 7 }
            if = { limit = { c:BYZ = { has_variable = oe_fs_r3 } } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_r3 value = c:BYZ.var:oe_fs_r3 } }
        }
        add_to_variable_list = { name = oe_fs_done target = scope:oe_fs_pk1 }
        change_variable = { name = oe_fs_park_n add = 1 }
    }
    oe_fs_free_1 = yes
}
# BYZ scope. The empire holds nothing of the region any more: the programme ends (its centre may open again).
oe_fs_drop_1 = {
    var:oe_fs_p1 ?= { remove_variable = oe_fs_stage }
    change_variable = { name = oe_fs_lost_n add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_e12 ?= 1 } oe_fs_e12_clear = yes }
    oe_fs_free_1 = yes
}
# BYZ scope. Slot 1 is free again.
oe_fs_free_1 = {
    remove_variable = oe_fs_p1
    remove_variable = oe_fs_p1_reg
    remove_variable = oe_fs_p1_st
    remove_variable = oe_fs_p1_w
    remove_variable = oe_fs_p1_pick
    remove_variable = oe_fs_p1_r2
    remove_variable = oe_fs_p1_tcd
    remove_variable = oe_fs_p1_dl
    remove_variable = oe_fs_p1_dlt
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- slot 2 (BYZ variables oe_fs_p2*: the centre, its region, step, months, step 2's place and result)
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_fs_open_c. Slot 2 takes the new programme.
oe_fs_take_2 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_fs_p2 value = scope:oe_fs_open_c }
    set_variable = { name = oe_fs_p2_reg value = scope:oe_fs_open_c.var:oe_theme_region }
    set_variable = { name = oe_fs_p2_st value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_fs_p2_w value = 0 }
}
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_fs_pc = the centre of slot 2. One month of the programme (scheduler row 29, via oe_fs_a_monthly).
oe_fs_tick_2 = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { oe_fs_pc_held = yes } }
        oe_fs_drop_2 = yes
    }
    # step 1, the register: 24 months, war months not counted
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_fs_p2_st ?= 1 }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_fs_pc_paused = yes } } change_variable = { name = oe_fs_p2_w add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_p2_w >= 24 } oe_fs_enter2_2 = yes }
    }
    # step 2, the settlers: the colonisation line does the work (oe_col_start: its event, its price, its slots). Done
    # when the place we gave it carries the line's marks of a settlement (oe_col_kind and the 20-year oe_col_cd: the
    # place was sparse, i.e. without oe_col_cd, when it was picked, so an old oe_col_kind alone does not count).
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_fs_p2_st ?= 2 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_fs_p2_pick ?= { has_variable = oe_col_kind has_variable = oe_col_cd } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_fs_p2_r2 value = 1 }
            oe_fs_enter3_2 = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { NOT = { oe_fs_pc_sparse = yes } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_fs_p2_r2 value = 2 }
            oe_fs_enter3_2 = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { NOT = { oe_fs_pc_paused = yes } }
            change_variable = { name = oe_fs_p2_w add = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:oe_fs_p2_w >= 36 }
                set_variable = { name = oe_fs_p2_r2 value = 3 }
                oe_fs_enter3_2 = yes
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_p2_tcd } oe_ml_free = yes oe_col_can_resettle = yes }
                oe_fs_try_2 = yes
            }
        }
    }
    # step 3, forts and soldier-farmers: oe_fs.12 (one at a time; waits for the lock at most 6 months)
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_fs_p2_st ?= 3 }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { oe_fs_pc_paused = yes } NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_p2_dlt } NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_e12 } }
            change_variable = { name = oe_fs_p2_w add = 1 }
            if = { limit = { OR = { oe_ml_free = yes var:oe_fs_p2_w >= 6 } } oe_fs_send_12_2 = yes }
        }
    }
}
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_fs_pc. Into step 2; a region without sparse land passes it at once (result 2).
oe_fs_enter2_2 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_fs_p2_st value = 2 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_fs_p2_w value = 0 }
    scope:oe_fs_pc = { set_variable = { name = oe_fs_stage value = 2 } }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { oe_fs_pc_sparse = yes } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_fs_p2_r2 value = 2 }
        oe_fs_enter3_2 = yes
    }
}
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_fs_pc. Step 2's try: the thinnest sparse place of the region becomes the colonisation line's
# target (scope:oe_col_pick, its contract) and oe_col_start runs; self-check: the line took it as its target (aerr 21).
oe_fs_try_2 = {
    ordered_owned_location = { limit = { var:oe_theme_region ?= scope:oe_fs_pc.var:oe_theme_region oe_col_sparse = yes } order_by = oe_fs_lowpop save_scope_as = oe_col_pick }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_pick }
        set_variable = { name = oe_fs_p2_pick value = scope:oe_col_pick }

# ======================================================================== part A: readout and test helpers (test page 30)
# BYZ scope. One debug_log line (fsalog): opened, error, parked, lost, the event's slot, then each slot.
oe_fs_a_log = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_p1 } var:oe_fs_p1 = { save_scope_as = oe_fs_pc } if = { limit = { oe_fs_pc_paused = yes } set_variable = oe_fs_z1 } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_p2 } var:oe_fs_p2 = { save_scope_as = oe_fs_pc } if = { limit = { oe_fs_pc_paused = yes } set_variable = oe_fs_z2 } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_p3 } var:oe_fs_p3 = { save_scope_as = oe_fs_pc } if = { limit = { oe_fs_pc_paused = yes } set_variable = oe_fs_z3 } }
    debug_log = "oe_fs A opened=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_a_n')|0] slots=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_prog_n')|0] aerr=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_aerr')|0] parked=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_park_n')|0] lost=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_lost_n')|0] e12=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_e12')|0] | p1: reg=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_p1_reg')|0] st=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_p1_st')|0] w=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_p1_w')|0] r2=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_p1_r2')|0] paused=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_z1')|0] | p2: reg=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_p2_reg')|0] st=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_p2_st')|0] w=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_p2_w')|0] r2=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_p2_r2')|0] paused=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_z2')|0] | p3: reg=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_p3_reg')|0] st=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_p3_st')|0] w=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_p3_w')|0] r2=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_p3_r2')|0] paused=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_z3')|0]"
    remove_variable = oe_fs_z1
    remove_variable = oe_fs_z2
    remove_variable = oe_fs_z3
}
# BYZ scope. fsaopen: the best region opens at once, free of charge (the AI's choice of region; the opening's own rules).
oe_fs_test_aopen = {
    oe_fs_best_center = yes
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_best_c }
        var:oe_fs_best_c = { save_scope_as = oe_fs_open_c }
        oe_fs_prog_open = yes
        oe_fs_a_log = yes
    }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_fs A test: no region may open a programme (3+ places of ours there, 2+ sparse or one gained lately; none running there)" }
    remove_variable = oe_fs_best_c
}
# BYZ scope. fsaai: the AI's opening without the roll and without is_ai (it pays).
oe_fs_test_aai = {
    if = { limit = { oe_fs_can_open = yes } oe_fs_ai_open = yes oe_fs_a_log = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_fs A test: cannot open (calm, a free slot, 3 Authority and 100 gold needed)" }
}
# BYZ scope. fsaadv: every running step's clock to its end (steps 1 and 2 move on at the next month; step 3 sends).
oe_fs_test_aadv = {
    if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_p1_st ?= 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_p1_w value = 24 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_p1_st ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_p1_w value = 36 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_p1_st ?= 3 } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_p1_w value = 6 } remove_variable = oe_fs_p1_dlt }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_p2_st ?= 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_p2_w value = 24 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_p2_st ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_p2_w value = 36 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_p2_st ?= 3 } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_p2_w value = 6 } remove_variable = oe_fs_p2_dlt }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_p3_st ?= 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_p3_w value = 24 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_p3_st ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_p3_w value = 36 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_p3_st ?= 3 } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_p3_w value = 6 } remove_variable = oe_fs_p3_dlt }
    oe_fs_a_log = yes
}
# BYZ scope. fsas2: step 2's try now for the first slot at step 2 (needs the colonisation line's own conditions).
oe_fs_test_as2 = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_col_can_resettle = yes } } debug_log = "oe_fs A test: oe_col_can_resettle fails (Authority 2, gold, a free migration slot, no cooldown, sparse land)" }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_p1_st ?= 2 oe_col_can_resettle = yes } var:oe_fs_p1 = { save_scope_as = oe_fs_pc } oe_fs_try_1 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_p2_st ?= 2 oe_col_can_resettle = yes } var:oe_fs_p2 = { save_scope_as = oe_fs_pc } oe_fs_try_2 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_p3_st ?= 2 oe_col_can_resettle = yes } var:oe_fs_p3 = { save_scope_as = oe_fs_pc } oe_fs_try_3 = yes }
    oe_fs_a_log = yes
}
# BYZ scope. fsae12: the first slot straight to step 3, then oe_fs.12 at once (no lock).
oe_fs_test_ae12 = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_p1 }
        var:oe_fs_p1 = { save_scope_as = oe_fs_pc }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { var:oe_fs_p1_st ?= 3 } } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_p1_r2 } } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_p1_r2 value = 3 } } oe_fs_enter3_1 = yes }
        oe_fs_e12_clear = yes
        oe_fs_send_12_1 = yes
    }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_fs A test: no programme in slot 1 (press fsaopen first)" }
}
# BYZ scope. fsafort (probe P6): the fort of step 3 a for the first slot, without the event (it costs 150 gold).
oe_fs_test_afort = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_p1 }
        var:oe_fs_p1 = { save_scope_as = oe_fs_pc }
        oe_fs_prep_12 = yes
        remove_variable = oe_fs_r3
        oe_fs_fort_do = yes
        debug_log = "oe_fs A probe P6: r3=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_fs_r3').GetValue|0] (1 castle built, 2 stand-in modifier, 7 no site or no gold) aerr=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_aerr')|0] (31: the castle was tried and is not there; 32: the engine charged its own price all the same and it was paid back)"
        remove_variable = oe_fs_r3
        remove_variable = oe_fs_fort_at
        remove_variable = oe_fs_th_s
        remove_variable = oe_fs_th_p
    }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_fs A probe P6: no programme in slot 1 (press fsaopen first)" }
}
# BYZ scope. fsaclr: forget part A (modifiers, castles and settlers already given stay; the centres may open again).
oe_fs_test_areset = {
    oe_fs_test_breset = yes
    oe_fs_e12_clear = yes
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_p1 } var:oe_fs_p1 = { remove_variable = oe_fs_stage } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_p2 } var:oe_fs_p2 = { remove_variable = oe_fs_stage } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_p3 } var:oe_fs_p3 = { remove_variable = oe_fs_stage } }
    oe_fs_free_1 = yes
    oe_fs_free_2 = yes
    oe_fs_free_3 = yes
    every_in_list = { variable = oe_fs_done remove_variable = oe_fs_stage remove_variable = oe_fs_r2 remove_variable = oe_fs_r3 }
    clear_variable_list = oe_fs_done
    remove_variable = oe_fs_a_on
    remove_variable = oe_fs_a_n
    remove_variable = oe_fs_aerr
    remove_variable = oe_fs_park_n
    remove_variable = oe_fs_lost_n
    remove_variable = oe_fs_r3
    remove_variable = oe_fs_open_at
    remove_variable = oe_fs_ajob
}
